title: Lessee Qualification Standards for ComfortLease Equipment Leases
content:
## Standard

A ComfortLease Equipment Leases agreement is signed only:

1. by the owner of the home, where the system requires the lessee to own the home;
2. with a credit tier at or above the system's minimum credit tier;
3. for an installed value of at least the system's minimum lease amount; and
4. with homeowner's insurance covering the leased equipment, where the system requires that insurance.

Credit tiers run from Tier 1, the strongest, to Tier 4. A tier "at or above" the minimum is the minimum tier itself or any stronger tier.

## Requirements by system

| Leased system | Lowest credit tier accepted | Tiers accepted | Lessee must own the home | Homeowner's insurance on the equipment required | Minimum installed value |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ComfortLease Gas Furnace | Tier 3 | Tier 1, 2 or 3 | Yes | Yes | $3500.00 |
| ComfortLease Central Air | Tier 3 | Tier 1, 2 or 3 | Yes | Yes | $3500.00 |
| ComfortLease Heat Pump | Tier 3 | Tier 1, 2 or 3 | Yes | Yes | $3500.00 |
| ComfortLease Furnace & Central Air | Tier 3 | Tier 1, 2 or 3 | Yes | Yes | $3500.00 |
| ComfortLease Dual-Fuel System | Tier 2 | Tier 1 or 2 | Yes | Yes | $3500.00 |
| ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone | Tier 3 | Tier 1, 2 or 3 | Yes | Yes | $3500.00 |

Because every system requires both home ownership and homeowner's insurance covering the equipment, all four conditions apply to every ComfortLease lease.

## Condition by condition

| Condition | Met when | Not met when |
|---|---|---|
| Ownership | The applicant owns the home | The applicant does not own the home (for example, a tenant) |
| Credit | Credit tier is the system's lowest accepted tier or stronger | Credit tier is weaker than the lowest accepted tier |
| Installed value | Installed value is $3500.00 or more | Installed value is below $3500.00 |
| Insurance | Homeowner's insurance covers the leased equipment | No homeowner's insurance covering the equipment |

Each condition is required: a lease is signed only where all four are met, and an applicant who misses any one of them does not meet these standards.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical applicants)

- An installed value of exactly $3500.00 meets the minimum ("at least"); an installed value of $3499.99 does not.
- A Tier 3 homeowner, insured, for a ComfortLease Central Air installation valued at $5000.00 meets every condition in this standard.
- The same Tier 3 homeowner applying for the ComfortLease Dual-Fuel System does not meet the credit condition, since that system accepts Tier 1 or Tier 2 only.
- A Tier 4 applicant does not meet the credit condition for any ComfortLease system.
